fields.description: Bulgari Lighthouse is a branded residential tower on Jumeira Bay Island. Four- and five-bedroom penthouses lead up to a three-level Sky Villa. Mediterranean gardens, large terraces and a private arrival sequence distinguish the building from the neighbouring resort’s existing residences.

overview: The five-bedroom TypeB drawing includes a pool, private gym and service rooms. The Sky Villa spans three levels; its overall area must not be repeated and added once per floor.
research.locationNote: Jumeira Bay Island, Dubai, beside the Bulgari resort setting. Marina, spa and dining services are nearby hospitality facilities; charges, booking conditions and actual residential access require confirmation.
research.priceNote: Meraas retains AED 63m on a page marked sold out. Property Finder advertises 99m as its current lowest listed guide while its original developer units are marked out of stock. These different selections do not establish a project-wide minimum, allocation or guaranteed resale value.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 20% launch payment, 70% during construction and 10% handover. No dated current primary calendar was retrieved. GoldPillars’ detailed instalments support 90/10, but its summary incorrectly prints 30% handover; the inconsistent 120% summary is excluded.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder reportsMarch 2027; GoldPillars givesJune 2027. No retrieved current primary document resolves the quarter difference, so the headline is withheld. Confirm the chosen agreement’s delivery terms.
